messages:
maya: quick preflight — running a 2h loadtest tomorrow 2026-03-22 09:00 UTC, need standby GPUs for burst. Target 12 A100s (can use H100 fallback). any quota/slot constraints? vendor availability? i've got a tf PR ready (WIP).
liam: heads up — apac A100 stock is thin this week, us-east2 still has capacity. can we shift region? also opened quota ticket #4567 with cloud support.
tess: +1 to region move if latency ok. maya — drop the PR link and the tf snippet you plan to apply.
maya: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/1428 (WIP)

maya: terraform snippet:
```hcl
module \"standby_pool\" {
  source = \"git::ssh://git.redwood.internal/infra/modules/gpu-pool.git\"
  region = \"us-east2\"
  sku = \"A100\"
  desired = 12
  burst = true
}
```
liam: that looks fine. if we move regions update the routing policy in the canary config: `canary.region = \"us-east2\"`. also i'll run an availability probe and paste results in a sec.
liam: probe output: `available_slots: 8 in us-east2; fallback_slots: 20 H100 in eu-west1`
alex: i can lend 4 nodes from demo-standby pool for the 2h if procurement signs off. cost ballpark ~ $120/hr extra.
procurement-bot: PO check: PO #789 pending approval. finance needs justification + expected spend.
jordan: we should do a 30m canary at 08:30 UTC to validate model latency across region shift. canary steps in runbook: `smoke -> perf -> failover`
tess: maya can you add the canary run to the PR description and tag @oncall? also add `route_policy: prefer_low_latency` for the first 10m.
maya: done — updated PR description and added `canary: 2026-03-22T08:30Z` and tagged @oncall in the PR thread.
liam: i requested a temporary quota bump via support ticket 4567 for us-east2 +12 A100s. cloud replied: \"pending internal approval, ETA 6h\"
alex: i'll pre-allocate 4 from demo-standby and leave a 30min buffer. i pushed a small tf change to use `demo-standby` as soft-burst pool when `standby_pool.available < desired`.
maya: snippet for soft-burst toggle included in PR.
maya: @procurement-bot can you nudge finance? this needs to clear before 04:00 UTC to avoid manual swap.
procurement-bot: finance update: asked for justification email; send to finance@redwood with subject `PO 789 — demo borrow for loadtest`.
maya: sending now. cc @alex.
jordan: deploy-bot — can you schedule the canary at 08:30 UTC (region us-east2) and post the link when scheduled?
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: https://deploy.redwood.internal/canaries/2026-03-22/standby-burst-us-east2 — run id c-88f2 ✅
liam: quick note — if quota isn't approved, plan B: 8 A100 in us-east2 + 4 H100 in eu-west1 with routing policy `latency_threshold = 120ms`. that will add ~40ms p90 for some requests.
tess: please call that out in the PR and update the alert thresholds for increased p90.
maya: done. PR updated with plan B.
alex: finance replied — approved PO 789 for the 6h window. you should be able to borrow nodes now.
maya: sweet. i'll merge the PR 15m before canary and kick off the canary.
jordan: i'll be on watch for canary metrics at 08:30. slack alert channel: #eng-runtime.
liam: i verified pool now shows `available_slots: 12` in us-east2 after demo borrow. running a small smoke: `kubectl run smoke-nginx --image=nginx --replicas=2 -l run=smoke`
maya: ok merging now.
maya: merged PR and applied infra. starting canary prep. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary started — https://deploy.redwood.internal/canaries/2026-03-22/standby-burst-us-east2/c-88f2/logs
jordan: first 10m smoke looks good. p50/p90 within expected. continue to full 30m.
maya: thanks everyone. will post a short postmortem if anything odd pops during the test.
liam: nice and smooth. marking thread resolved. ✅
